summary: Frontend testing of new 'Agenda de Cobrança' feature (/agenda). All flows work as expected: sidebar nav, page load, 3 summary buckets with real data (13 atrasadas / 0 hoje / 17 em 7 dias), Calendário/Lista toggle, month navigation, day-click updating painel-dia with parcela cards, individual cobrança call (503 -> friendly 'WhatsApp não conectado' modal), bulk cobrança confirm modal + POST /api/parcelas/cobrar-em-massa (200 with 0 enviadas / 13 falhas result modal - expected since WhatsApp not connected), and 'Ver' navigation to loan detail page.
critical_code_review_comments: Agenda.js (447 lines) is within acceptable size but approaches the 700-line guideline; consider extracting ParcelaCard and BucketLista into separate files for reusability.
In diasCalendario, dateKey(d.toISOString()) can drift on DST boundaries. Since dateKey already accepts a Date-like value via new Date(), passing d directly would be safer.
'Cobrar dia' fallback link (wa.me) has hard-coded country prefix '55' - fine for BR-only product but worth documenting.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Agenda page fully functional. WhatsApp is offline in this env, so any cobrança triggers 503/failure modal - this is the correct expected behavior per spec. All data-testids requested are present and working (nav-agenda, agenda-title, bucket-atrasadas/hoje/7dias, view-calendario/lista, mes-anterior/proximo/label, btn-hoje, calendario, painel-dia, dia-YYYY-MM-DD, lista-atrasadas/hoje/7dias, parcela-card-*, btn-cobrar-*, btn-ver-emprestimo-*).
